text:
alex: anyone seeing eu-west GPU warmpool not joining? nodes stuck in 'decrypting' for ~30m
maria: yep noticed, autoscaler shows 12 failed joins, KMS decrypts returning 403/timeouts
alex: logs show TLS handshake to kms.eu.internal timed out, looks like recent egress rules might be the cause
jon: i pushed a default-deny egress earlier to tighten things for audit - could be collateral
ryan: ops-bot recorded change: `firewall-change: applied deny-egress-unknown-14:02 UTC`
liz: security: that rule was intended to block external admin ranges, we had exception for keystore but maybe it wasn't scoped properly
maria: snippet from node logs: `2026-03-21T14:10:12Z keystore: decrypt error: connection reset by peer`
alex: i grep'd the sg rules - there is an entry dropping 100.64.0.0/10 which is where the privatelink NAT for kms lives
jon: ugh, my terraform diff accidentally expanded the deny CIDR. my bad. plan: add an allow for the keystore service tag and revert the overly broad deny
maria: can we add the allow with logging so audit still sees traffic? e.g. `allow svc=keystore -> kms.* (tcp/443) log`
liz: yes, add explicit allow with `log=true` and note approver in audit. we can keep the rest of the deny in place
ryan: executing: `terraform apply -target=module.firewall.aws_security_group_rule.allow-keystore-10064` (ops-bot shows apply started)
ops-bot: terraform apply complete: 1 added, 5 unchanged, 0 destroyed
alex: warmpool nodes rejoining now, 8/12 healthy
maria: still seeing 4 nodes with `KMS decrypt timeout` - might be KMS throttling/backpressure after the outage
jon: will ping keystore team to spin up a replica in eu or bump throttling quota for short window
liz: i've filed audit task `AUDIT-3872` to capture the rule change, approver, and why CIDR was widened; linking to infra ticket
alex: cost note: enabling the allow + audit logging increases log volume. we should sample audit logs 1% during remediation to reduce S3 egress cost
maria: agree. set sampling flag on the capturer: `audit.capture.sample_rate=0.01` for 30m
ryan: created ticket INF-789: `eu-keystore-egress-exception` and scheduled a 30m postmortem at 15:15 UTC
alex: if nodes don't stabilize in +15m we'll failover inference traffic to the dedicated eu-fallback pool (lower qps, higher cost)
maria: monitoring checks show pod readiness slowly climbing, i'll keep watch and report status
jon: apologies for the blast radius. will add a preflight check to alert when deny CIDR touches privatelink ranges
liz: also add a policy to require `svc=keystore` tag for any allow edits and a 1-hr guardrail cooldown
ops-bot: incident severity updated: P1 -> P2 at 14:28 UTC
alex: thanks all, keep updates here. if anything new pops up call me on pager
maria: on it :thumbsup:
